description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Direction No. 57 - Directing all Products, distributors and Traders of Bottled Drinking Water not to expose their Products without bearing the SLS Product Certification mark w.e.f. 01.09.2016
reasoning: This gazette contains a regulatory direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes mandatory requirements for bottled drinking water containers, specifying they must bear the SLS certification mark based on Sri Lanka Standard SLS 1336:2008. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification.
